spec.title: Network Observability - WAN Site Investigation
spec.description: Investigate one site of the global WAN - discovery inventory, federation liveness, local topology, changes and probe experience - and compare it with every other site.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Discovery site (device_info site) or federation spoke (spoke_id).

panels.title: Site summary - $site
panels.description: State of the selected site now. Devices reporting: network_topology_device_info now vs seen in the last hour; links: network_topology_edge_info adjacencies with at least one end at the site; vendors and OS versions from device_info labels; exporter: the discovery exporter (instance) reporting the site's devices. Federation (spokes only): network_topology_federation_spoke_up, push age from network_topology_federation_spoke_last_push_timestamp_seconds, spoke-side network_topology_federation_spoke_push_failures_total where the pushing exporter reports to this stack, and hub-wide network_topology_graph_updates_rejected_total (that counter has no spoke label). Probe success: probe_success averaged over the range for the probe region mapped to this site.

targets.expr: count(((network_topology_edge_info) and on (instance, src_device) max by (instance, src_device) (label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}[1h]), "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"))) or ((network_topology_edge_info) and on (instance, dst_device) max by (instance, dst_device) (label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}[1h]), "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"))))
max by (instance, device_id) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}[1h])) unless on (instance, device_id) network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}
100 * avg(avg_over_time(probe_success[$__range]) * on (instance, job, probe) group_left (region) max by (instance, job, probe, region) (sm_check_info{region=~"$region"}))

panels.title: Site model and mappings
panels.description: How discovery sites, federation spokes and probe regions are tied together on this dashboard.

options.content:
A site is a discovery site (`site` on `network_topology_device_info`) or a federation spoke (`spoke_id` on the hub's `network_topology_federation_spoke_*`). The picker lists both.

| Site | Devices from | Federation | Probes |
|---|---|---|---|
| hq-dc1 | netobs-ent-dc1 | none | US |
| global | netobs-glb-hub (Clos core) | the hub | all |
| emea-dc1 / amer-dc1 | netobs-glb-hub (WAN core) | none | EMEA / US |
| emea-edge1 = dc-emea | netobs-spoke-emea | pushes as dc-emea | EMEA |
| dc-amer, dc-apac | none | hub view only | US, APAC |
| dc-edge-1, dc-edge-2 | none | hub view only | EMEA |

**dc-emea is the only spoke with devices**: the emea-edge1 exporter pushes under that identity, so both names show the same 9 devices plus dc-emea liveness. **dc-amer, dc-apac, dc-edge-1 and dc-edge-2 are federation-only**: their exporters do not report here, so device, link and change panels stay empty and only hub liveness and push age exist. amer-dc1 is not assumed to be dc-amer.

Probe region follows site location (hq-dc1 Chicago, dc-edge-1 Dublin, dc-edge-2 Amsterdam); the global core is compared against all regions. Push age is judged against a 300 s staleness budget.

panels.title: Devices present vs seen in the last hour
panels.description: Per minute: devices of the site reporting network_topology_device_info, devices seen in the trailing hour (last_over_time 1h), and the gap between them as unreachable bars. A device that stops answering SNMP drops out of device_info while it stays in the hourly view. Federation-only spokes have no device inventory and show nothing here.

defaults.noValue: No device inventory for this site

panels.title: Site liveness timeline
panels.description: Green when healthy, red when not. Devices all reporting: every device seen in the last hour is in network_topology_device_info. Spoke: network_topology_federation_spoke_up on the hub for the site's spoke identity. Discovery graph fresh: network_topology_graph_stale = 0 on the exporter covering the site. Rows appear only where the site has that signal.

panels.title: Federation push age vs staleness budget
panels.description: Seconds since the hub last accepted a push from the site's spoke (network_topology_federation_spoke_last_push_timestamp_seconds) and, where the pushing exporter reports to this stack, the spoke's own last successful push (network_topology_federation_spoke_push_last_success_unix). The red line and band mark the 300 s staleness budget. Empty for sites that are not federation spokes.

panels.title: Devices and topology at the site
Devices at the site
panels.description: One row per device seen at the site in the last hour (network_topology_device_info). Tier comes from the device naming convention (edge-fw, wan-core, spine, leaf, host). Uptime is the last reported network_topology_device_uptime_seconds; state is Reachable while device_info is present and Unreachable when it was seen in the last hour but has stopped reporting. Click a device to open its investigation view.

targets.expr: max by (instance, device_id, tier, vendor, os_version) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_uptime_seconds[1h]) * on (instance, device_id) group_left (tier, vendor, os_version) label_replace(max by (instance, device_id, vendor, os_version) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}[1h])), "tier", "$1", "device_id", "(edge-fw|wan-core|spine|leaf|host|ext-peer).*"))

max by (instance, device_id, tier, vendor, os_version) ((label_replace(max by (instance, device_id, vendor, os_version) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}[1h])), "tier", "$1", "device_id", "(edge-fw|wan-core|spine|leaf|host|ext-peer).*") * 0) + on (instance, device_id) group_left () (max by (instance, device_id) (network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}) or max by (instance, device_id) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info{site="$dsite"}[1h])) * 0))

panels.title: Site topology and links leaving the site
panels.description: Devices at the site laid out by tier (edge and WAN core, spine, leaf, host) with every discovered adjacency touching them (network_topology_edge_info). The top row holds what is outside the site: neighbours at another site (blue, links leaving the site) and external peers the hub sees at the domain boundary (purple, network_topology_boundary_observation_info). Green: reporting; red: seen in the last hour but no longer reporting. Grey links are present, red links were lost within the last hour, dashed purple links are boundary observations. For a federation-only spoke the diagram shows the spoke's push path to the hub, coloured by network_topology_federation_spoke_up. Scroll to zoom, drag to pan, hover for details.

panels.title: Topology changes and conflicts touching the site
panels.description: Topology change log lines (event=topology_change, by change_kind) and neighbour conflict lines (event=topology_conflict) from the discovery exporter covering the site, filtered to lines where src_device or dst_device is one of the site's devices. Counts per 2 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (change_kind) (count_over_time({change_kind=~".+", source="network-topology-exporter", instance=~"$dexp"} | src_device=~"$devs" or dst_device=~"$devs" [$__interval]))
sum by (conflict_type) (count_over_time({conflict_type=~".+", source="network-topology-exporter", instance=~"$dexp"} | src_device=~"$devs" or dst_device=~"$devs" [$__interval]))

defaults.noValue: No change events for this site

panels.title: Exporter change counters and hub rejections
panels.description: network_topology_change_total on the discovery exporter covering the site (exporter-wide: the counter has no device label, so on the hub it also covers the rest of the global core). For federation spokes, network_topology_graph_updates_rejected_total on the hub by reason; that counter is hub-wide with no spoke label, so it shows rejections from all spokes. Increase per 2 minutes.

panels.title: Change and conflict log for the site
panels.description: Raw discovery events from {source="network-topology-exporter"} on the site's exporter where src_device or dst_device is a site device.

targets.expr: {source="network-topology-exporter", instance=~"$dexp"} | src_device=~"$devs" or dst_device=~"$devs" | logfmt | line_format "{{.event}}  {{if .change_kind}}{{.change_kind}} {{.proto}}  {{.src_device}} {{.src_port}} -> {{.dst_device}} {{.dst_port}}{{else}}{{.conflict_type}}  {{.src_device}} {{.src_port}}  sources={{.sources}}{{end}}"

panels.title: External experience - probes in the region serving $site
Probe success in range
panels.description: Share of successful runs per check over the selected range: probe_success averaged over time, joined to sm_check_info for the probe region mapped to the site.

targets.expr: label_replace(100 * avg by (job, probe, region) (avg_over_time(probe_success[$__range]) * on (instance, job, probe) group_left (region) max by (instance, job, probe, region) (sm_check_info{region=~"$region"})), "probe", "$1", "probe", "synthkit-(.*)")

panels.title: Probe latency by check
panels.description: probe_duration_seconds per check run from the region's probe, plus the p95 across those checks from the probe_all_duration_seconds histogram (5m rate).

targets.expr: max by (job, region) (probe_duration_seconds * on (instance, job, probe) group_left (region) max by (instance, job, probe, region) (sm_check_info{region=~"$region"}))

label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, region) (rate(probe_all_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) * on (instance, job, probe) group_left (region) max by (instance, job, probe, region) (sm_check_info{region=~"$region"}))), "probe", "$1", "probe", "synthkit-(.*)")

panels.title: Probe result per check
panels.description: probe_success per check run from the region's probe, worst result in each 2 minute bucket: green pass, red fail.

targets.expr: label_replace(min by (job) (probe_success * on (instance, job, probe) group_left (region) max by (instance, job, probe, region) (sm_check_info{region=~"$region"})), "probe", "$1", "probe", "synthkit-(.*)")

panels.title: Site comparison - every site of the global network
panels.description: One row per site (discovery sites and federation spokes). Devices: network_topology_device_info now / seen in the last hour. Links: edge_info adjacencies with an end at the site. Device availability: per-minute share of the site's devices reporting, averaged over the range; unreachable minutes: minutes in range with at least one device missing. Spoke liveness and down minutes: network_topology_federation_spoke_up on the hub. Changes and conflicts: Loki topology_change / topology_conflict lines in range, attributed to the site of src_device and dst_device. Probe success: probe_success for the site's probe region (global core: mean of all regions). Click a site name to investigate it; the selected site is highlighted.

targets.expr: count by (site) (max by (site, instance, src_device, src_port, dst_device, discovery_proto) ((network_topology_edge_info * on (instance, src_device) group_left (site) max by (instance, src_device, site) (label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_device_info[1h]), "src_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)"))) or (network_topology_edge_info * on (instance, dst_device) group_left (site) max by (instance, dst_device, site) (label_replace(last_over_time(network_topology_device_info[1h]), "dst_device", "$1", "device_id", "(.*)")))))

100 * avg_over_time(((count by (site) (network_topology_device_info) or count by (site) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info[1h])) * 0) / count by (site) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info[1h])))[$__range:1m])

sum_over_time(((count by (site) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info[1h])) - (count by (site) (network_topology_device_info) or count by (site) (last_over_time(network_topology_device_info[1h])) * 0)) > bool 0)[$__range:1m])
100 * avg by (region) (avg_over_time(probe_success[$__range]) * on (instance, job, probe) group_left (region) max by (instance, job, probe, region) (sm_check_info))
